system.description:
Includes any medieval variant of the Molotov Cocktail.

Negative Traits: Fragile

Concealability: Jacket (until lit)

Damage: One aggravated health level

Availability: Resources x4, Rare

Special Ability: Incendiary, Spray, Two-Hand Requirement

Uses the Athletics Ability for combat retests.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages), Rules, Systems and Drama
